rewrites.yea_description: Voted for Senate File 34, which counts more school building space when the state pays districts for maintenance. The Senate first refused the House changes, then voted 20-7 to accept them, and the bill became law as 2025 chapter 145.
rewrites.nay_description: Voted against Senate File 34, which counts more school building space when the state pays districts for maintenance. The Senate first refused the House changes, then voted 20-7 to accept them, and the bill became law as 2025 chapter 145.
